transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, honestly, what really scared me enough to come in is... I've been hearing things. Like, I'll be at home and I hear my name being called from the hallway. And it even happened once at work, at the warehouse, when I knew for a fact nobody was around. But it sounds so real, you know? Just as clear as if my husband was standing right next to me talking. It's really been messing with my head.
Have you been feeling unusually high, energized, or euphoric lately?

Yeah, I have. At first, I felt really fired up... just almost unstoppable, honestly, especially with my craft business and setting up all these new house rules. But it wasn't just a good feeling. I'd end up snapping at my husband over the smallest little comment. It just felt like he was trying to hold me back from what I needed to do.
During this time, have you been needing much less sleep than usual?

Yeah, I have. For a while there, I was sleeping maybe... two or three hours a night. And I wasn't tired at all. I'd wake up just ready to go. It honestly felt like sleeping was just wasting time that I needed to be spending on my projects.
Have the voices ever happened when your mood felt normal—not unusually up or unusually down?

No, they really haven't. The... the voice calling my name, that only happened during that stretch when I was barely sleeping and talking a mile a minute, just feeling like I had to fix everything right then. Before that started, and then later when I got really low and just wanted to withdraw from everybody... I didn't hear anything like that. It was only when I was so wound up.
Have you ever had the voices continue for at least two weeks when your mood was not unusually high or unusually low?

No, like I was just saying... it really only happened during that specific time. When I was running on no sleep, talking a mile a minute, and just... driven to do all those projects. When I was feeling normal, before all that started, I didn't hear anything. And then when I crashed and got really low and just wanted to hide away from everyone... nothing then, either. It was strictly tied to when I was so wound up.
